title: Build vs. Buy: Should Your Bank Build an AI Agent or License One?
summary: A decision framework for banks and credit unions weighing whether to build AI agents in-house or license a regulated-finance platform — covering total cost, time to value, model risk, and the in-house capabilities you actually need.
